newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse trade mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse trade mostly lower.

text.p: 1251 GMT - German DAX index of leading shares ends thin-volume bourse trade slightly off day's lows, but just above Friday's IBIS dealings close.
* 30-share DAX closes bourse down 11.39 points at 2,671.86.
* December DAX future up 0.5 points at 2,681.5.
* Viag climbs after confirmation of BT merger with MCI.
* VW, Daimler up, interest in auto sector. Daimler says to publish nine month figures on Thursday.
* VEW lower despite saying expects moderate rise in net profits in full year 1996.
